snippet.title: BACKFIRE release - Gameplay Trailer [Epilepsy Warning]
snippet.description:
GET BACKFIRE ON iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/backfire/id1445218977?ls=1&mt=8
GET BACKFIRE ON ANDROID: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=game.GRYNSQYD.BACKFIRE

Backfire is a fast paced action game about cleansing a demon from an arcade machine. Upgrade your tools, and avoid certain death.

One twist: your ship only fires from the back.

FOLLOW BACKFIRE ON TWITTER: https://twitter.com/TheGreenSquid
JOIN THE BACKFIRE DISCORD: https://discord.gg/EWnudzs
